title: Lost Mary BM600 Blueberry Sour Raspberry Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Designed exclusively for the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these replacement pods allow you to enjoy the same effortless vaping experience without replacing your entire device. Each pack contains two prefilled 2ml disposable pods with 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth, comfortable throat hit and rapid nicotine relief. With each pod delivering up to 600 puffs (depending upon personal usage and vaping style), these convenient replacements offer an easy way to keep your device topped up with your favourite Lost Mary flavours. Simply remove the old pod, click in a new one, and continue enjoying a consistently satisfying vape. The Blueberry Sour Raspberry flavour delivers a rich fusion of juicy blueberries and tangy raspberries, balancing rich sweetness with a sharp, syrupy sweet edge. The vibrant berry medley creates a refreshingly fruity inhale, followed by a crisp, tangy exhale that lingers on the tastebuds. Ideal for vapers who enjoy layered berry blends with a tangy, sweet-sour kick, the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods offer a convenient and cost-effective way to experience the signature flavours of the Lost Mary BM600 range.
